propositions: A recalled finding with empty evidence list is re-injected verbatim on every subsequent review, creating a self-feeding ratchet that prevents convergence even after the plan is edited to address it.
Prior findings are recalled and re-persisted without the _recall marker, making them indistinguishable from fresh findings and eligible for recall again on the next run.

Pass-2 validity verification does not act as a backstop because recalled candidates are injected with no evidence grounding, allowing the verifier to confirm bare assertions instead of testing them against the current plan.
The fix carries persisted evidence and impact from prior findings into recall injections so Pass-2 can re-ground claims against the current plan text.
Findings with no persisted grounding evidence are excluded from recall eligibility, breaking the ratchet and working on already-written sidecars without migration.
Recall is suppressed when the prior sidecar's material_fingerprint differs from the current one, treating fresh-finder silence on changed material as evidence the edit resolved the finding.
